name: Debian
onCreateCommand: npm install -g cspell && uv python install && uv sync --all-extras
postCreateCommand: sudo rm -f /etc/apt/sources.list.d/yarn.list && sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y texlive-latex-base texlive-latex-recommended texlive-latex-extra texlive-fonts-recommended texlive-fonts-extra cm-super ghostscript latexmk dvisvgm dvipng texlive-xetex texlive-luatex libasound2 libfreetype6 libgl1 libglu1-mesa ca-certificates curl xz-utils unzip libglib2.0-0 libx11-6 libxext6 libxrender1 libsm6 libfontconfig1 && sudo apt-get clean && sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/* && chmod +x scripts/*.sh && if [ -f third_party/WolframEngine_*_LIN.sh ]; then sudo bash scripts/install-wolfram-engine.sh --skip-download; fi
postAttachCommand: echo '\n=== Wolfram Engine Setup ===' && if command -v wolframscript &> /dev/null; then echo 'Wolfram Engine is installed.'; if ! wolframscript -code '1+1' &> /dev/null; then echo 'Run: ./scripts/activate-wolfram.sh to activate'; fi; else echo 'Wolfram Engine not installed. Place installer in third_party/ and rebuild.'; fi
